brief.content: Keep released content, media and identities. Change the Coast photo shade opacity from .34 to .65, let the Home heading use its available column width with a balanced native tablet grid, and replace false inquiry connection statements with host-neutral destination and receipt-test guidance. Keep the no-live-availability and no-reservation-service claims.
